description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to credits management, including functions for retrieving credits per USD, converting USD to credits, and formatting credits with suffixes.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the number of credits per USD, defaulting if environment variable is not set.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits using the credits per USD rate and rounds the result.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a credits amount as a string with 'credits' suffix.
